hypothesis: A small model's likelihood for the actual words of four answers may reveal differences between candidate capabilities that are missed by letter scores and option-order changes.
measurement: On multiple-choice prompts already flagged by the fixed Qwen and Math gate, use the independent 1.5B Math model to teacher-force each option after the question and after a neutral prefix. Record length-normalized conditional likelihood and domain-conditional pointwise mutual information. Do not run any candidate to score new prompts.
comparison: Fit identical 95D, 200-question candidate profiles with either eight existing helper views or those eight plus the option-text signal. Freeze the analytic design before measuring the new features or inspecting outcomes. The primary test uses the 532 previously unscored five-task-corpus questions in the new official coverage reserve (398 MMLU, 48 MathQA, 86 MedMCQA). Exclude the entire coverage reserve, both previous peer reserves and the probe panels from shared supervision. The primary reference is a new full-data TextMF fit withholding all coverage groups. The original 4,985 questions are supplementary.
